### Health Analytics with R · Module 03: Statistical Inference
***
**This capstone integrates NB-01 through NB-07 into a single publication-quality inference pipeline.**

**Research question:** What patient-level, clinical, and socioeconomic factors are independently associated with 30-day hospital readmission, and does heart failure modify the effect of diabetes?

**Pipeline stages:**
1. Descriptive analysis & Table 1
2. Unadjusted effect estimates (RR, OR) with forest plot
3. Survival analysis (KM curves + log-rank)
4. Logistic regression — confounding assessment & adjusted ORs
5. Test for effect modification (diabetes × HF interaction)
6. Count outcome model (ED visits — NB regression)
7. Sensitivity analysis (E-values, multiple comparisons)
8. Methods narrative & publication figure

**Estimated time:** 4 hours | **Level:** Advanced

## 0. Analysis Plan & Data Assembly

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(MASS, exclude = "select")
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(epitools)
library(pROC)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

mod03_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod03")
dir.create(mod03_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

logistic <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
N <- 2500
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4)

set.seed(99)

# ── Covariates ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
age           <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18), 92))
sex           <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer         <- sample(
  c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
  N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03)
)
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension  <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.7 * base[, 1] - 0.2))
hf            <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
los_days      <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
admit_type    <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"), N, replace = TRUE,
                        prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
n_comorb      <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd

# ── Outcomes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
readmit_logit <- (-3.0 + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.7 * hf + 0.8 * diabetes * hf  # interaction
                  + 0.3 * copd + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15
                  + 0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency")
                  + 0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid")
                  + 0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted    <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(readmit_logit))

# Survival: time to readmission
hazard      <- exp(-3.8 + 0.5 * hf + 0.3 * diabetes + 0.15 * (los_days > 7))
surv_days   <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rexp(N, rate = hazard), 1), 365))
censor_time <- as.integer(round(runif(N, 30, 365)))
event_obs   <- as.integer(surv_days <= censor_time)
duration    <- ifelse(event_obs == 1, surv_days, censor_time)

# ED visits (NB distributed)
log_mu_ed <- (-0.3 + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.8 * hf + 0.4 * copd + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 + log(2))
ed_visits <- rnbinom(N, size = 2, mu = exp(log_mu_ed))

df <- tibble(
  patient_id     = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age            = age,
  age_std        = (age - 62) / 15,
  sex            = sex,
  payer          = relevel(factor(payer), ref = "Private"),
  admit_type     = relevel(factor(admit_type), ref = "Elective"),
  los_days       = los_days,
  los_gt7        = as.integer(los_days > 7),
  diabetes       = diabetes,
  hypertension   = hypertension,
  hf             = hf,
  copd           = copd,
  n_comorb       = n_comorb,
  readmitted     = readmitted,
  duration_days  = duration,
  event_observed = event_obs,
  ed_visits      = ed_visits,
  log_follow_up  = log(2)
) |>
  mutate(
    age_group = cut(age, breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95),
                    labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"))
  )

cat(sprintf("Capstone dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))
cat(sprintf("Readmission rate : %.1f%%\n", mean(readmitted) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Event rate (surv): %.1f%%\n", mean(event_obs) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Mean ED visits   : %.2f  (var=%.2f)\n", mean(ed_visits), var(ed_visits)))
```

## 1. Table 1 — Baseline Characteristics

```{r}
wilson_ci <- function(k, n) {
  z <- qnorm(0.975); p <- k / n; den <- 1 + z^2 / n
  mid <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / den
  hw  <- (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / den
  c(round((mid - hw) * 100, 1), round((mid + hw) * 100, 1))
}

skewness <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))^3, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)^3

g0 <- df |> filter(readmitted == 0)
g1 <- df |> filter(readmitted == 1)
cat(sprintf("TABLE 1 — Baseline characteristics by 30-day readmission (N=%d)\n", N))
cat(sprintf("%-30s %20s %20s %8s\n", "Variable", "Not readmitted", "Readmitted", "p"))
cat(paste(rep("=", 82), collapse = ""), "\n")
cat(sprintf("%-30s %20s %20s\n", "N", format(nrow(g0), big.mark = ","),
            format(nrow(g1), big.mark = ",")))

for (pair in list(c("age", "Age (years)"), c("los_days", "LOS (days)"),
                  c("n_comorb", "N comorbidities"))) {
  col <- pair[[1]]; label <- pair[[2]]
  sk <- skewness(df[[col]])
  if (abs(sk) > 0.8) {
    s0 <- sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", median(g0[[col]]),
                  quantile(g0[[col]], 0.25), quantile(g0[[col]], 0.75))
    s1 <- sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", median(g1[[col]]),
                  quantile(g1[[col]], 0.25), quantile(g1[[col]], 0.75))
    p  <- wilcox.test(g0[[col]], g1[[col]], alternative = "two.sided")$p.value
  } else {
    s0 <- sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(g0[[col]]), sd(g0[[col]]))
    s1 <- sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(g1[[col]]), sd(g1[[col]]))
    p  <- t.test(g0[[col]], g1[[col]])$p.value
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-30s %20s %20s %8.4f\n", label, s0, s1, p))
}

for (pair in list(
  c("sex", "Female sex"), c("payer", "Payer"), c("admit_type", "Admit type"),
  c("diabetes", "Diabetes"), c("hf", "Heart failure"), c("copd", "COPD")
)) {
  col <- pair[[1]]; label <- pair[[2]]
  ct <- table(df[[col]], df$readmitted)
  p  <- if (nrow(ct) >= 2) chisq.test(ct)$p.value else 1
  cat(sprintf("\n%-30s %20s %20s %8.4f\n", label, "", "", p))
  cats <- unique(na.omit(df[[col]]))
  cats <- cats[seq_len(min(4, length(cats)))]
  for (catv in cats) {
    n0 <- sum(g0[[col]] == catv); p0 <- n0 / nrow(g0) * 100
    n1 <- sum(g1[[col]] == catv); p1 <- n1 / nrow(g1) * 100
    cat(sprintf("  %-28s %5d (%4.1f%%)       %5d (%4.1f%%)\n",
                as.character(catv), n0, p0, n1, p1))
  }
}
```

## 2. Unadjusted Forest Plot — All Exposures

```{r}
EXPOSURES <- list(
  c("diabetes", "Diabetes"), c("hf", "Heart failure"),
  c("copd", "COPD"), c("hypertension", "Hypertension"),
  c("los_gt7", "LOS > 7 days")
)

fp_df <- bind_rows(lapply(EXPOSURES, function(pair) {
  col <- pair[[1]]; label <- pair[[2]]
  a <- sum(df[[col]] == 1 & df$readmitted == 1)
  b <- sum(df[[col]] == 1 & df$readmitted == 0)
  c <- sum(df[[col]] == 0 & df$readmitted == 1)
  d <- sum(df[[col]] == 0 & df$readmitted == 0)
  OR <- if (b * c > 0) (a * d) / (b * c) else NA_real_
  se <- sqrt(1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c + 1 / d)
  p  <- chisq.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))$p.value
  tibble(label = label, OR = OR,
         lo = exp(log(OR) - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(log(OR) + 1.96 * se), p = p)
}))

p_fp <- ggplot(fp_df, aes(OR, reorder(label, OR),
                          colour = ifelse(OR > 1 & p < 0.05, "#DC2626", "#2563EB"))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = sprintf("OR=%.2f (%.2f–%.2f), p=%.3f", OR, lo, hi, p)),
            hjust = -0.05, size = 3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "Unadjusted ORs for 30-day readmission") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 140, 5, 5))

print(p_fp)
ggsave(file.path(mod03_dir, "capstone_forest.png"), p_fp,
       width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 120)
```

## 3. Survival Analysis

```{r}
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    hf_lab = factor(hf, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No HF", "Heart failure")),
    dm_lab = factor(diabetes, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No diabetes", "Diabetes"))
  )

km_hf <- survfit(Surv(duration_days, event_observed) ~ hf_lab, data = df)
km_dm <- survfit(Surv(duration_days, event_observed) ~ dm_lab, data = df)
lr_hf <- survdiff(Surv(duration_days, event_observed) ~ hf, data = df)
lr_dm <- survdiff(Surv(duration_days, event_observed) ~ diabetes, data = df)
p_lr_hf <- 1 - pchisq(lr_hf$chisq, length(lr_hf$n) - 1)
p_lr_dm <- 1 - pchisq(lr_dm$chisq, length(lr_dm$n) - 1)

p_km_hf <- ggsurvplot(
  km_hf, data = df, conf.int = TRUE, palette = c("#2563EB", "#DC2626"),
  xlab = "Days post-discharge", ylab = "Readmission-free S(t)",
  title = "Time to readmission by HF", legend.title = "", ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
p_km_hf$plot <- p_km_hf$plot +
  annotate("label", x = Inf, y = 0.15, hjust = 1.05,
           label = sprintf("Log-rank p = %.4f", p_lr_hf), size = 3.3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05))

p_km_dm <- ggsurvplot(
  km_dm, data = df, conf.int = TRUE, palette = c("#16A34A", "#7C3AED"),
  xlab = "Days post-discharge", ylab = "Readmission-free S(t)",
  title = "Time to readmission by diabetes", legend.title = "", ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
p_km_dm$plot <- p_km_dm$plot +
  annotate("label", x = Inf, y = 0.15, hjust = 1.05,
           label = sprintf("Log-rank p = %.4f", p_lr_dm), size = 3.3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05))

p_km <- p_km_hf$plot + p_km_dm$plot
print(p_km)
ggsave(file.path(mod03_dir, "capstone_km.png"), p_km, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 120)

cox_fit <- coxph(Surv(duration_days, event_observed) ~ hf + diabetes + copd, data = df)
cat("\nCox PH (capstone):\n")
print(broom::tidy(cox_fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE))
```

## 4. Multivariable Logistic Regression + Interaction Test

```{r}
# Main effects model
model_main <- glm(
  readmitted ~ diabetes + hf + copd + hypertension + los_gt7 +
    age_std + sex + payer + admit_type,
  data = df, family = binomial()
)

# Model with diabetes × HF interaction
model_int <- glm(
  readmitted ~ diabetes * hf + copd + hypertension + los_gt7 +
    age_std + sex + payer + admit_type,
  data = df, family = binomial()
)

lr <- anova(model_main, model_int, test = "LRT")
lr_stat <- lr$Deviance[2]
lr_p    <- lr$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

cat("Likelihood ratio test — diabetes × HF interaction:\n")
cat(sprintf("  LR = %.3f, df=1, p = %.4f\n\n", lr_stat, lr_p))

# Report adjusted ORs from best model
best_model <- if (!is.na(lr_p) && lr_p < 0.05) model_int else model_main
OR_table <- broom::tidy(best_model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  transmute(term, adj_OR = round(estimate, 3),
            CI_lo = round(conf.low, 3), CI_hi = round(conf.high, 3),
            p = round(p.value, 3)) |>
  arrange(desc(adj_OR))
cat("Adjusted ORs from best model:\n")
print(OR_table)
```

## 5. Model Evaluation

```{r}
df$pred_prob <- predict(best_model, type = "response")
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$readmitted, df$pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)
auc   <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
brier <- mean((df$readmitted - df$pred_prob)^2)
coords_y <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"),
                         best.method = "youden")
opt_thr <- as.numeric(coords_y$threshold[1])
opt_fpr <- 1 - as.numeric(coords_y$specificity[1])
opt_tpr <- as.numeric(coords_y$sensitivity[1])
roc_df <- tibble(fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities, tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities)

calib_df <- tibble(y = df$readmitted, p = df$pred_prob) |>
  mutate(bin = ntile(p, 10)) |>
  group_by(bin) |>
  summarise(prob_pred = mean(p), prob_true = mean(y), .groups = "drop")

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(fpr, tpr)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = tpr), fill = "#2563EB", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(colour = "#1E3A8A", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(x = opt_fpr, y = opt_tpr), colour = "#DC2626", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       title = sprintf("ROC Curve  (AUC=%.3f)", auc)) +
  coord_equal()

p_cal <- ggplot(calib_df, aes(prob_pred, prob_true)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = "#DC2626", size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Observed fraction", title = "Calibration Plot") +
  annotate("label", x = 0.05, y = 0.90, hjust = 0,
           label = sprintf("Brier = %.3f", brier), size = 3.3)

p_eval <- p_roc + p_cal
print(p_eval)
ggsave(file.path(mod03_dir, "capstone_model_eval.png"), p_eval,
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 120)
cat(sprintf("AUC: %.3f  |  Brier: %.3f\n", auc, brier))
```

## 6. Count Model — NB Regression for ED Visits

```{r}
df$log_follow <- log(2)
model_pois_ed <- glm(
  ed_visits ~ diabetes + hf + copd + age_std + payer,
  data = df, family = poisson(), offset = log_follow
)
disp_ratio <- model_pois_ed$deviance / model_pois_ed$df.residual
cat(sprintf("Poisson overdispersion (deviance/df): %.2f\n", disp_ratio))

model_nb <- MASS::glm.nb(
  ed_visits ~ diabetes + hf + copd + age_std + payer + offset(log_follow),
  data = df
)

irr_nb <- broom::tidy(model_nb, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  filter(!term %in% c("(Intercept)")) |>
  transmute(term, IRR = round(estimate, 3),
            CI_lo = round(conf.low, 3), CI_hi = round(conf.high, 3),
            p = round(p.value, 3)) |>
  arrange(desc(IRR))
cat("NB regression — ED visits IRR:\n")
print(irr_nb)
cat(sprintf("AIC Poisson: %.1f  |  AIC NB: %.1f\n", AIC(model_pois_ed), AIC(model_nb)))
```

## 7. Sensitivity Analysis — E-Values

```{r}
e_value <- function(RR) {
  if (RR < 1) RR <- 1 / RR
  RR + sqrt(RR * (RR - 1))
}
or_to_rr <- function(OR, prev) OR / ((1 - prev) + prev * OR)
prev <- mean(df$readmitted)

get_or <- function(model, name) {
  cf <- coef(model)
  if (name %in% names(cf)) exp(unname(cf[[name]])) else NA_real_
}

cat("E-value sensitivity analysis\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
for (pair in list(
  list("Diabetes (adj OR)", get_or(best_model, "diabetes")),
  list("HF (adj OR)", get_or(best_model, "hf")),
  list("diabetes:hf (adj OR)", get_or(best_model, "diabetes:hf"))
)) {
  label <- pair[[1]]; OR_val <- pair[[2]]
  if (is.na(OR_val) || OR_val <= 0) next
  rr <- or_to_rr(OR_val, prev)
  ev <- e_value(rr)
  cat(sprintf("  %-30s: adj OR=%.2f, E-value=%.2f\n", label, OR_val, ev))
}

# Multiple comparisons across five comorbidities (BH FDR)
raw_p <- vapply(c("diabetes", "hf", "copd", "hypertension", "los_gt7"), function(v) {
  chisq.test(table(df[[v]], df$readmitted))$p.value
}, numeric(1))
cat("\nBH FDR-corrected comorbidity tests:\n")
print(round(p.adjust(raw_p, method = "BH"), 4))
```

## 8. Publication Summary Figure

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
# Panel A — Unadjusted ORs
p_a <- ggplot(fp_df, aes(OR, reorder(label, OR),
                         colour = ifelse(OR > 1 & p < 0.05, "#DC2626", "#2563EB"))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = sprintf("%.2f", OR)), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(x = "Unadjusted OR (95% CI)", y = NULL, title = "A  Unadjusted effect estimates") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel B — Comorbidity prevalence by readmission
comorb_long <- df |>
  select(readmitted, diabetes, hf, copd, hypertension) |>
  pivot_longer(-readmitted, names_to = "comorb", values_to = "flag") |>
  group_by(readmitted, comorb) |>
  summarise(prev = mean(flag) * 100, .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(grp = if_else(readmitted == 1, "Readmitted", "Not readmitted"))

p_b <- ggplot(comorb_long, aes(comorb, prev, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Prevalence (%)", fill = NULL, title = "B  Comorbidities by outcome") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, size = 8))

# Panel C — ROC
p_c <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(fpr, tpr)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = tpr), fill = "#2563EB", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(colour = "#1E3A8A", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       title = "C  ROC Curve", subtitle = sprintf("AUC=%.3f", auc)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  coord_equal()

# Panel D — Calibration
p_d <- ggplot(calib_df, aes(prob_pred, prob_true)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = "#DC2626", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Predicted prob", y = "Observed fraction", title = "D  Calibration") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.92, hjust = 0, size = 3,
           label = sprintf("Brier=%.3f", brier)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel E — Interaction
int_rates <- df |>
  group_by(hf, diabetes) |>
  summarise(rate = mean(readmitted) * 100, .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(hf_lab = if_else(hf == 1, "HF", "No HF"))

p_e <- ggplot(int_rates, aes(diabetes, rate, colour = hf_lab, group = hf_lab)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("No DM", "Diabetes")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("No HF" = "#2563EB", "HF" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Readmission rate (%)", colour = NULL,
       title = "E  DM × HF interaction") +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3,
           label = sprintf("LR-test p=%.3f", lr_p)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel F — NB IRR
p_f <- ggplot(irr_nb, aes(IRR, reorder(term, IRR),
                          colour = ifelse(IRR > 1 & p < 0.05, "#DC2626", "#2563EB"))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lo, xmax = CI_hi), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = CI_hi, label = sprintf("IRR=%.2f", IRR)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(x = "IRR (95% CI)", y = NULL, title = "F  NB regression — ED visits IRR") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.margin = margin(5, 70, 5, 5))

# Panel G — Risk stratification
df$risk_tier <- cut(
  df$pred_prob, breaks = c(0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, 1.0),
  labels = c("Low\n(<10%)", "Moderate\n(10-20%)", "High\n(20-35%)", "Very high\n(>35%)"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)
tier_df <- df |>
  group_by(risk_tier) |>
  summarise(rate = mean(readmitted) * 100, n = n(), .groups = "drop")

p_g <- ggplot(tier_df, aes(risk_tier, rate, fill = risk_tier)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%\n(n=%d)", rate, n)), vjust = -0.1, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2563EB", "#16A34A", "#D4A017", "#DC2626"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Predicted risk tier", y = "Actual readmission rate (%)",
       title = "G  Risk stratification") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_pub <- (p_a | p_b) /
  (p_c | p_d | p_e) /
  (p_f | p_g) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Statistical Inference Pipeline — 30-Day Readmission Cohort (N=2,500)"
  )
print(p_pub)
ggsave(file.path(mod03_dir, "capstone_summary_figure.png"), p_pub,
       width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved at 300 dpi: capstone_summary_figure.png\n")
```

## 9. Methods Narrative Draft

> **Statistical Methods (Module 03 Capstone)**
>
> Continuous variables were summarised as mean ± SD or median [IQR] based on the D'Agostino skewness test; categorical variables as N (%). Group differences were assessed with Mann-Whitney U (skewed continuous) or chi-square tests (categorical).
>
> Unadjusted odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were derived from 2×2 contingency tables using the log method. Multivariable-adjusted ORs were estimated via logistic regression. Model selection followed the 10% change rule for confounding: a predictor was retained as a confounder if its inclusion changed the exposure OR by ≥10%. A likelihood ratio test was used to assess the diabetes × heart failure interaction.
>
> Survival analysis used the Kaplan-Meier estimator with log-rank tests for group comparisons. Emergency department visit counts were modelled with negative binomial regression with a person-time offset; overdispersion was confirmed by the Cameron-Trivedi auxiliary test.
>
> Model discrimination was assessed by the C-statistic (AUC-ROC); calibration by the Hosmer-Lemeshow test and calibration plot. Sensitivity to unmeasured confounding was quantified via E-values (VanderWeele & Ding, 2017). Multiple comparisons across five comorbidities were corrected using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate. All analyses were conducted in R 4.3+ (dplyr, stats, broom, survival, survminer, MASS).

## 10. Final Knowledge Check

1. The interaction LR test gives p = 0.004. Write two sentences interpreting this for a clinical audience.
2. AUC = 0.73. Is this model ready for clinical decision support? What additional validation steps are needed?
3. You have 15 predictors in your logistic model with N = 2,500. Is this overfitting? Use EPV (events per variable) to assess.
4. The HF IRR in the NB model is 2.1. How does this differ from the HF OR in the logistic model, and why?
5. An E-value of 3.1 for the diabetes OR. Explain this to a non-statistician colleague.

```{r}
# Exercise 3 — EPV calculation
n_events <- sum(df$readmitted)
n_params <- length(coef(best_model)) - 1  # exclude intercept
EPV <- n_events / n_params
cat(sprintf("Events (readmissions) : %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("Model parameters      : %d\n", n_params))
cat(sprintf("EPV (events per var)  : %.1f\n\n", EPV))
if (EPV >= 10) {
  cat("EPV ≥ 10: Model is adequately powered (rule of thumb).\n")
} else if (EPV >= 5) {
  cat("EPV 5–10: Borderline — consider penalised regression (Ridge/LASSO).\n")
} else {
  cat("EPV < 5: Overfitting risk — reduce predictors or use penalised logistic.\n")
}
```
